# Homo Hotel Happy Hour (4H)

> Homo Hotel Happy Hour, Inc. ("4H") is Tulsa's free monthly LGBTQIA+ cocktail happy hour. On the first Friday of every month, 4H takes over a different Tulsa hotel bar, welcomes everyone from regulars to first-timers, and raises money for a local charity through an all-night raffle. Admission is always free, no cover, no dress code.

## Key facts
- Name: Homo Hotel Happy Hour, Inc. (also known as "4H")
- Location: Tulsa, Oklahoma (rotating hotel-bar venues)
- Cadence: First Friday of every month
- Cost: Free admission, always. Optional charity raffle.
- Mission: A welcoming LGBTQIA+ community mixer that gives back to local Tulsa causes.
- Contact / RSVP: Meetup and Facebook group (links below)

## Upcoming event
- Friday, September 11, 2026, 6:00 to 8:00 PM at the Hilton Garden Inn Tulsa South, 8202 S 100th E Ave, Tulsa, OK 74133, near 81st and Mingo just off Highway 169. September moves to the second Friday because Labor Day weekend took the first one. Admission is free, the hotel is including pool access, and the charity raffle benefits Council Oak Men's Chorale.

## Recent events
- August 7, 2026: First Friday at Courtyard Downtown, inside the historic Atlas Life Building. Raffle proceeds benefited PFLAG Tulsa.
- July 3, 2026: First Friday at The Campbell Hotel, 2636 E 11th St, Tulsa, OK, a restored 1927 Spanish Colonial and the first full-service hotel on Route 66 in Tulsa.

## Stats
- 300+ total guests across all events
- $0 cover charge, now, then, and always
- Monthly since February 2026, a different Tulsa hotel bar every time
- One local charity spotlighted at every event (see beneficiaries above)

## Charity partners (past beneficiaries)
- Council Oak Men's Chorale (counciloak.org), Tulsa's gay men's chorus since 1998
- Oklahomans for Equality (okeq.org), home of the Dennis R. Neill Equality Center
- Paws in Need (pawsinneedtulsa.com), veterinary care and food for pets in Tulsa families facing hardship
- Queer Lit Collective (instagram.com/queerlitcollective)
- PFLAG Tulsa (pflag.org/chapter/pflag-tulsa)
